name: Aino Aika
source:
Aika loves reading and enjoys writing as well. She particularly loves romance books. She struggles to be honest about her feelings because she is shy and she comes off as cold because of this. [url=/c98216]Chizuru[/url] often asks Aika to join the Drama Club and act in screenplays.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
